notes.title: Heroine's Quest v1.2.7 update
notes.notes:
Heroine's Quest has been updated to fix bugs reported by Steam players. Furthermore, one of our fans stepped up to create a full Portuguese translation; so a big round of applause to lbatalhacs for that!! The new build is fully compatible with the previous one.


 Fixed accented letters in translations, and when restoring a game in another language.
 Fixed crash if attacking Heime in the cage; and during Thrivaldi cutscene.
 Fixed Egther battle glitch for the rogue.
 Fixed Fremont bypass glitch.
 Fixed Norn dialogue in Italian language.
 Fixed passing Aurvandel's challenge without the proper spells.
 Improved some NPC responses in unusual cases.

notes.title: Linux version and Russian translation
notes.notes:
We have released a new version (1.2.3) that includes Linux support, as well as localization into Russian. Thanks to all the people who have helped test this, and particularly to translator Atronax.

This also includes a number of fixes for bugs reported in the forum. Have a great christmas!

notes.title: Update for soundtrack
notes.notes:
Hello! An update is available - it is the soundtrack - which will be added in your Library > Music section. Now you can enjoy all the tracks via the Steam music player or from your hard drive. We hope you enjoy Ragna Rock - the original soundtrack for Heroine's Quest.

Please note a couple of small, additional updates may occur over the next week as we tweak the soundtrack page. We also apologize that the soundtrack was not available via Steam earlier as intended, but hope you now enjoy this addition to your Steam music collection.
